# PVT_Sensing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
On-chip sensing of Process, Voltage, and Temperature variations to calibrate neuromorphic circuit behavior. Enables robust inference and learning in neuromorphic hardware under real-world environmental variability.
